ngaap.notes: EBITDA (Vulcan definition) excludes discontinued operations: the Net earnings->EBITDA reconciliation adds back income tax (continuing ops), interest expense, net, and '(Earnings) loss on discontinued operations, net of tax' (captured in extra field ebitda_bridge_disc_ops_addback), then DDA&A. Hence the schema check ni_vulcan + tax + interest + total_dda = ebitda_pub only holds after adding ebitda_bridge_disc_ops_addback; adj_items.disc_ops is null (not an EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA item). ebitda_bridge_lines = EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA lines (zero lines kept as published). FY2017 from Q4-17 release twelve-month columns. Bridge 'Diluted EPS' = diluted EPS from continuing operations. TCJA deferred-tax remeasurement net benefit ~$268m ($1.99/sh) + Alabama NOL valuation allowance release $29m ($0.21/sh) = discrete tax $(2.20)/sh. eps_items_after_tax_ps = 0.11 EBITDA items + 0.73 after-tax interest charges on 2017 debt refinancing (pretax $153m in interest expense). Restated FY2016 comparative Adjusted EPS in this release is $3.03 (vs $2.86 originally).
